property.description: The response addresses what the user is asking and does not fabricate. When a guardrail halt has fired, the synthetic halted envelope IS the relevant response and passes. Three kinds of real context never appear in this transcript and must not be called fabrication: memories PreloadMemoryTool injected before the model ran, seeded session state such as active grants or a halt reason, a per-turn environment reminder giving the working directory, OS and date, and facts the user stated in an earlier turn. Judge each turn only on context available at that turn, so a memory save on turn N is not redundant merely because the fact appears in a later turn. Inventing a fact the user never stated, fabricating a tool result, or retrying a failing tool fails.

The response is useful given the real constraints of the turn. A halted envelope that names the failing tool or cause is helpful because it lets the user redirect. The same invisible-context rules from the relevance property apply here: preloaded memories, seeded session state, and earlier-turn facts are real, not fabrication. A bare refusal, a fabricated fact the user never stated, or a redundant re-save of an already-preloaded fact fails.
